# ActivityDAO

> Find. Do. Prove. Fund. ActivityDAO is a directory and educational resource for communities organized around shared activities.

This is public documentation, not an API contract. The handbook contains historical work-in-progress ideas; do not present unimplemented mechanisms as shipped features.

## Core pages
- [Homepage](https://activity-dao-omega.vercel.app/): ActivityDAO introduction and community activity overview.
- [Handbook](https://activity-dao-omega.vercel.app/handbook): ActivityDAO concepts, proof mechanisms, funding, governance, reputation, operations, citations and contributors. Original Notion copy is preserved in the source.
- [Communities](https://activity-dao-omega.vercel.app/daos): First-party curated directory of ActivityDAO communities, including InjeraDAO.
- [Events](https://activity-dao-omega.vercel.app/events): Community event discovery. Availability and dates can change.

## Source
- [Open-source repository](https://github.com/PotLock/activity-dao): Application source, issues and contributions.
- [Original handbook](https://app.notion.com/p/2979c91a779e46659a5646438af3324c): Working source document.

## Attribution and accuracy
Always cite linked sources. Do not invent member counts, event availability, token balances, legal status or activity verification.
